text: me l'havien recomanat molt i la vaig probar. em va anar bé, en part, durant una temporada. però el disseny és massa complicat, cosa que pot fer que passis massa temps a l'aplicació. a més, tant això com que tingui coses com micro-compres dins l'aplicació (element potencialment addictiu) em sembla xungo tenint en compte que és una app adreçada específicament a un perfil ("target") especialment vulnerable a addiccions a les pantalles i a enredar-se en compres compulsives. ojo cuidao.
author: Saku
developer_reply: Hi there, Saku! Thanks for giving Habitica a try and for your thoughtful feedback. All items that can be purchased are merely cosmetic and optional, but we understand their presence might not be right for everyone. We appreciate your thoughts and will keep them in mind as we continue to improve Habitica.

text: Molt útil per incentivar bons hàbits. És entretinguda (potser no es 100% intuitiva però hi ha tutorials arreu) i prou personalitzable com perque s'adapti a les necessitats de cada moment. Molt xula la part de configurar el teu personatge :)
author: Tatiana Dunyó
developer_reply: Hi there, Tatiana! Thanks so much for your review. We're happy to hear Habitica has been helpful for you and that you are enjoying building your avatar and customizing the app! If you’d like to share any feedback with us directly, you can do that via Menu - About - Support - Send Feedback.Happy adventuring!

text: Una APP completa per motivar a fer la feina, de forma divertida i molt ben desenvolupada. Perfecte per a gamers RPG, et sentiràs com a casa, i et tornaràs + productiu! Té 3 seccions basiques: tasques, hàbits, i pendents que proporcionen accés a recompenses. El teu personatge anirà pujant de nivell mentre completes les tasques, segons la seva dificultat. Podràs triar la classe: Guerrer, Mag, I Rogue. Fins i tot hi ha Guild, mascotes, i montures. Descobreix-la! Val la pena 🤩
author: 3v4 M
developer_reply: Thanks so much for your detailed review here. We're happy to hear what you like about Habitica! If you’d like to share any feedback with us directly, you can do that via Menu - About - Support - Send Feedback. Happy adventuring!

text: Great app! I love the idea and the different ways you can use its features to motivate yourself. The only complaint I have is that some things are left for the user to discover without any explanation whatsoever, like the class system. Would recommend to anyone who has a hard time setting up a schedule or getting things done.
author: David Alba
developer_reply: Hi, David! We're glad to hear you're finding Habitica to be useful and motivating. You may find the resources at Menu - About - Help and FAQ helpful. You can also find answers in the Wiki: https://habitica.fandom.com/wiki/Habitica_Wiki

text: Molt bona idea, i molt divertida. Llàstima que no tingui mode off-line (cal tenir sempre connexió per tot), que demani tants permisos, i no permeti exportar les tasques....
author: Òkar
developer_reply: Hi Okar, thanks for your review! We'll keep your feedback in mind as we continue to work to improve Habitica. You can contact us directly by going to Menu - About - Send Feedback if you'd like to give us additional details.

text: Just a way for lazy weirdos for motivate themselves. I love it.
